procedure_text: 环磺酮制备方法，其特征在于，包括如下的任意一个步骤： 根据权利要求1所述的方法，其中所述步骤(v)和(v′)分别为以下步骤： 根据权利要求2所述的方法，其中步骤(v-1)或(v′-1)的反应在贵金属催化剂和磷配体或其盐存在下进行，所述贵金属选自钯、铑、钌、铜、钴，优选钯催化剂，更优选氯化钯(PdCl2)、碳酸钯(PdCO3)、醋酸钯[Pd(OAc)2]、钯/碳(Pd/C)、三氟乙酸钯[Pd(OTFA)2]、双二亚苄基丙酮钯[Pd(dba)2]； 所述磷配体或其盐优选为1,3-(双二苯基膦)丙烷、1,4-双(二苯基膦)丁烷或者双[(4-N,N-二甲氨基)苯基]二叔丁基膦。 根据权利要求3所述的方法，其中反应溶剂是选自甲苯、1,4-二氧六环、乙二醇二甲醚、乙二醇二乙醚、二甲基亚砜(DMSO)、四氢呋喃(THF)、N,N-二甲基甲酰胺(DMF)中的一种或两种以上。
procedure_summary: The aryl bromide bearing the trifluoroethoxymethyl and methanesulfonyl groups is carbonylated with carbon monoxide and water over a noble metal catalyst and a phosphine ligand to give the corresponding benzoic acid.
notes: Claim 1 recites the process as any one of the drawn steps; the arrow at line 555 is this one, drawn bare, and claim 2 respecifies it at line 561 with CO and H2O on the arrow and calls it step (v-1). The bare (v) and the specified (v-1) are the same transformation, so they are one record and not two. reaction_class is other because the closed vocabulary has no carbonylation class; the transformation is a noble metal catalysed hydroxycarbonylation of an aryl bromide. The catalyst, ligand and solvent lists come from dependent claims 3 and 4, which apply to step (v-1) or (v'-1); they are alternatives from a claimed list, not a charge, and they are not drawn on the claim 2 arrow, which is ordinary claim structure and not a conflict. Document order puts this step first in the section even though it is fifth in the route. Cross-section handle: this section's drawing-only identifiers are the same SMILES strings A1 used in summary-of-the-invention, so the correspondence is by compound identifier, not by reaction_id. Prose and drawings agree here, so no drawing_text_conflict is raised. The claims print no charge, temperature, time, pressure or yield anywhere, which is why no_conditions stands on every record in this section.

procedure_summary: The same aryl bromide is carbonylated with carbon monoxide in the presence of cyclohexane-1,3-dione over a noble metal catalyst and a phosphine ligand, giving the enol ester directly.
notes: The primed label here is an alternative route, not a preferred wording: (v) gives the carboxylic acid, (v') gives the enol ester in one operation. Claim 1 draws it bare at line 557; claim 2 respecifies it at line 563 with CO on the arrow and cyclohexane-1,3-dione as a co-reactant, and calls it step (v'-1). One record for both. reaction_class is ester_formation, taken from the bond formed; the transformation is a noble metal catalysed alkoxycarbonylation and the vocabulary has no carbonylation class. Catalyst, ligand and solvent as for step (v), from dependent claims 3 and 4. procedure_summary: Side-chain bromination of the aryl methyl group to the benzylic bromide with a brominating reagent, bromine being the preferred one.
notes: The drawn arrow carries only the generic 溴代试剂 (brominating reagent); the prose at lines 585 and 603 defines it as bromine, N-bromosuccinimide, or hydrogen bromide combined with hydrogen peroxide, preferably bromine. procedure_text: 根据权利要求1至6中任意一项所述的方法，包括如下所示的中间体制备步骤： 根据权利要求7或8所述的方法，进一步包括如下步骤： 根据权利要求9所述的方法，其中步骤(vi)、和(vi′)分别为如下步骤：
procedure_summary: The aryl bromide is carbonylated to the benzoic acid, converted to the acid chloride, esterified with the cyclic dione and rearranged to tembotrione.
notes: Claim 9 calls this one further step (步骤, singular) and claim 10 respecifies it, so it is one record even though it is drawn as four arrows at lines 612 and 618: aryl bromide to benzoic acid (CO and H2O on the arrow at line 618), acid to acid chloride, acid chloride to the enol ester, ester to tembotrione. reaction_class and mechanism are taken from the final transformation, the ester to C-acyl rearrangement. is_one_pot is left false: the claims say nothing about isolation for (vi), and the one-pot option at lines 610 and 622 is stated for (vi') only, so asserting either way here would go beyond the text. Its first arrow is the same transformation as step (v), which is recorded separately because claim 1 claims it on its own; the overlap is the claims' own structure, not a duplicate. Two things the drawings withhold: no chlorinating agent is drawn on the acid to acid chloride arrow, and cyclohexane-1,3-dione is not drawn on the esterification arrow of this variant although the product incorporates it, so neither is carried on the record. The catalyst, ligand and solvent lists of claims 3 and 4 are not carried here: they are written for steps (v-1) and (v'-1), and claim 9 depends on claims 7 or 8, not on claim 3. procedure_summary: The aryl bromide is carbonylated in the presence of the cyclic dione to the enol ester, which rearranges to tembotrione; the claim allows the ester to be isolated or carried through without isolation.
notes: The shorter variant, drawn as two arrows at lines 614 and 620: aryl bromide plus cyclohexane-1,3-dione under CO to the enol ester, then rearrangement to tembotrione. One record, class and mechanism from the final transformation. is_one_pot is left false and one_pot_steps empty even though lines 610 and 622 say step (vi') or (vi'-1) may be run either stepwise with isolation of the intermediate ester or one-pot without isolating it: the claim offers both modes and asserts neither, and setting the flag would resolve an option the document deliberately leaves open. Both readings are recorded here instead. Its first arrow is the same transformation as step (v'), recorded separately because claim 1 claims it on its own.
